data.long_meaning: Riya is a Sanskrit word that means 'joy' or 'pleasure'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'riddhi' which means wealth or prosperity. Riya is also considered the name of the goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology. She is depicted as the goddess of abundance, beauty, and fertility. The name Riya carries the meaning “Joy, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Riya usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Riya was an important queen of the Chalukya dynasty in the Deccan region of India. She ruled from 1096 to 1118 CE and is best known for her military campaigns against the Chola and Western Chalukya kingdoms.
